```{r knit_opts}
  c("xml2", "magrittr", "rlang", "dplyr", "readr", "purrr", "ggplot2")
```

```{r set_up_inuring_graph_loss_data}
loss_events_tbl <- read_csv("demo_business/loss_events.csv")
loss_allocation_tbl <- read_csv("demo_business/loss_allocation_walkthrough.csv")

graph_nodes_tbl <- read_parquet("demo_business/nodes_tbl.parquet")
graph_edges_tbl <- read_parquet("demo_business/edges_tbl.parquet")


inuring_tblgraph <- build_inuring_tblgraph(graph_nodes_tbl, graph_edges_tbl)
```

```{r set_up_basics_examples}
#| echo: false

qs_cession <- 0.25

qs_tbl <- tibble(gross_loss = c(2e6, 10e6, 40e6)) |>
  mutate(
    ceded = qs_recovery(gross_loss, qs_cession),
    net   = gross_loss - ceded
    )

tower_loss <- 14e6

tower_tbl <- tibble(
  layer      = c("L1", "L2"),
  attachment = c(5e6, 10e6),
  limit      = c(5e6, 10e6)
  )

tower_recovery_tbl <- tower_recoveries(tower_loss, tower_tbl) |>
  transmute(
    layer,
    band     = glue("{fmt_limit(limit)}XS{fmt_limit(attachment)}"),
    recovery
    )

tower_retained <- tower_loss - sum(tower_recovery_tbl$recovery)

tower_display_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    layer    = "Retained",
    band     = glue("Below {fmt_m(min(tower_tbl$attachment))}"),
    recovery = tower_retained
    ),
  tower_recovery_tbl
  )

period_loss_vec <- c(8e6, 9e6, 10e6)
layer_attach    <- 5e6
layer_limit     <- 5e6
n_reinstate     <- 1

period_tbl <- tibble(
  event_loss    = period_loss_vec,
  occurrence    = period_recoveries(period_loss_vec, layer_attach, layer_limit),
  reinstatement = period_recoveries(
    period_loss_vec, layer_attach, layer_limit,
    cap = layer_limit * (1 + n_reinstate)
    ),
  aggregate     = period_recoveries(
    period_loss_vec, layer_attach, layer_limit,
    cap = layer_limit
    )
  )

order_loss    <- 10e6
order_cession <- 0.30

order_qs  <- \(x) qs_recovery(x, order_cession)
order_xol <- \(x) xol_recovery(x, attachment = 5e6, limit = 5e6)

order_tbl <- tibble(
  sequence = c("QS then XoL", "XoL then QS"),
  result   = list(
    apply_in_order(order_loss, list(order_qs, order_xol)),
    apply_in_order(order_loss, list(order_xol, order_qs))
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    first_ceded  = map_dbl(result, \(r) r$ceded[1]),
    second_ceded = map_dbl(result, \(r) r$ceded[2]),
    total_ceded  = first_ceded + second_ceded,
    net          = map_dbl(result, "subject")
    )
```


```{r set_up_synthetic_data}
#| echo: false

synth_dir <- "data_synthreins"

read_stats <- function(path) {
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    deframe() |>
    as.list()
}

mega_stats_lst  <- read_stats(glue("{synth_dir}/realistic_mega/stats.csv"))

mega_nodes_tbl <- read_parquet(glue("{synth_dir}/realistic_mega/nodes_tbl.parquet"))
mega_edges_tbl <- read_parquet(glue("{synth_dir}/realistic_mega/edges_tbl.parquet"))
mega_tblgraph  <- build_inuring_tblgraph(mega_nodes_tbl, mega_edges_tbl)
```

```{r set_up_mega_engine}
#| echo: false

source("recover_functions.R", keep.source = TRUE)

mega_data <- load_mega("data_mega")
mega_res  <- recover_losses(mega_data)
mega_anat <- loss_anatomy(mega_data, mega_res)

fmt_bn <- label_number(accuracy = 0.1, scale = 1e-9, suffix = "bn")
fmt_amt <- \(x) if_else(x >= 1e9, fmt_bn(x), fmt_m(x))

# "Casualty Liability (P001 2.1) 17XS5" -> "Casualty Liability 2.1 17XS5"
short_name <- \(x) str_replace(x, "\\(P001 ([0-9.]+)\\)", "\\1")

type_lbl <- c(
  quota_share = "Quota share", group_quota_share = "Group quota share",
  surplus = "Surplus", xol_per_risk = "XoL per risk",
  xol_per_occurrence = "XoL per occurrence", clash = "Clash",
  aggregate_xl = "Aggregate XL", stop_loss = "Stop loss", ilw = "ILW"
  )

# Okabe-Ito: proportional types in blues/greens, excess of loss in oranges
type_col <- c(
  group_quota_share = "#0072B2", quota_share = "#56B4E9", surplus = "#009E73",
  stop_loss = "#CC79A7", xol_per_risk = "#E69F00", xol_per_occurrence = "#D55E00",
  aggregate_xl = "#F0E442", clash = "#999999", ilw = "#000000"
  )

class_col <- c(attritional = "#56B4E9", large = "#E69F00", cat = "#D55E00")

slide_theme <- theme(
  text        = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text   = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title  = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
  strip.text  = element_text(size = 16)
  )

lob_name_vec <- with(mega_data$lob_df, setNames(name, lob_id))

loss_period_tbl <- gross_by(mega_res, period_id, loss_type) |>
  mutate(loss_type = factor(loss_type, levels = c("cat", "large", "attritional")))

top_event_tbl   <- gross_by(mega_res, event_id, loss_type, period_id) |>
  slice_max(gross, n = 1)
top_event_share <- top_event_tbl$gross / sum(loss_period_tbl$gross)

loss_orders <- round(log10(max(mega_data$loss_df$gross_loss) / min(mega_data$loss_df$gross_loss)))
```


```{r set_up_mega_examples}
#| echo: false

# one treaty over several lines of business: the clash with the widest footprint
clash_row <- mega_data$coverage_df |>
  count(treaty_id, name = "n_lob") |>
  inner_join(mega_data$treaty_df, by = "treaty_id") |>
  filter(treaty_type == "clash") |>
  arrange(desc(n_lob), name) |>
  slice(1)

clash_tbl <- mega_data$coverage_df |>
  filter(treaty_id == clash_row$treaty_id) |>
  transmute(
    Treaty             = short_name(clash_row$name),
    Type               = unname(type_lbl[clash_row$treaty_type]),
    `Line of business` = short_name(lob_name_vec[lob_id])
    ) |>
  arrange(`Line of business`)

# one event per loss class, and how many treaties it reaches
class_reach_tbl <- tibble(Class = names(mega_anat$example_events)) |>
  mutate(
    `Loss rows` = map_int(Class, \(k) nrow(mega_anat$example_loss_rows[[k]])),
    Treaties    = map_int(Class, \(k) nrow(mega_anat$who_sees_what[[k]]))
    )

who_cat_tbl <- mega_anat$who_sees_what$cat |>
  filter(is_indemnity) |>
  summarise(
    Treaties    = n(),
    `Max cells` = max(n_cells),
    Ceded       = sum(ceded),
    .by = treaty_type
    ) |>
  mutate(treaty_type = factor(treaty_type, levels = names(type_lbl))) |>
  arrange(treaty_type) |>
  transmute(
    `Treaty type` = type_lbl[as.character(treaty_type)],
    Treaties, `Max cells`, Ceded = fmt_amt(Ceded)
    )

ilw_cat_tbl <- mega_anat$who_sees_what$cat |> filter(!is_indemnity)

# the DAG alone versus the DAG plus a tie-break, against the generator's own ledger
topo_res  <- recover_losses(mega_data, order_by_topo_sort(mega_data))
cmp_kahn  <- compare_flows(mega_res, mega_data)
cmp_topo  <- compare_flows(topo_res, mega_data)

order_cmp_tbl <- tibble(
  `Application order`     = c("igraph::topo_sort()", "Kahn + chain_rank"),
  `Ceded rows matching`   = percent(
    c(cmp_topo$n_ceded_ok, cmp_kahn$n_ceded_ok) / cmp_kahn$n_generator,
    accuracy = 0.1
    )
  )

tower_edge_broken_n <- nrow(edge_violations(mega_data, mega_res$order))
```


```{r set_up_mega_summary}
#| echo: false

# provenance, read from the data directory's README: tier / seed / periods
mega_prov <- readLines("data_mega/README.md") |>
  str_subset(fixed("Tier / seed / phase / periods")) |>
  str_match("`(\\w+)` / (\\d+) / .* / (\\d+) \\|")

mega_tier    <- mega_prov[1, 2]
mega_seed    <- mega_prov[1, 3]
mega_periods <- as.integer(mega_prov[1, 4])

stopifnot(
  mega_periods == nrow(mega_data$period_df),
  nrow(mega_data$treaty_df) == mega_stats_lst$treaties,
  nrow(mega_data$edges_df)  == mega_stats_lst$edges
  )

# headline totals, and the conservation check gross = net + ceded
tot_gross <- sum(mega_res$cells$gross_loss)
tot_net   <- sum(mega_res$cells$net_loss)
tot_ceded <- sum(mega_res$ledger$ceded[mega_res$ledger$is_indemnity])

stopifnot(near(tot_gross, tot_net + tot_ceded))

ceded_type_tbl <- recoveries_by(mega_res, treaty_type) |>
  arrange(desc(ceded))

prop_share <- ceded_type_tbl |>
  filter(treaty_type %in% c("quota_share", "group_quota_share", "surplus")) |>
  pull(ceded) |>
  sum() / tot_ceded

top_treaty_tbl <- recoveries_by(mega_res, treaty_id, treaty_type) |>
  slice_max(ceded, n = 10) |>
  left_join(mega_data$treaty_df |> select(treaty_id, name), by = "treaty_id") |>
  mutate(label = short_name(name))

exhausted_tbl <- exhaustion(mega_res, mega_data) |>
  filter(exhausted) |>
  count(level, treaty_type)

# the biggest event, step by step in order of application (a tower is one step)
trace_event <- top_event_tbl$event_id

trace_payer_tbl <- mega_res$ledger |>
  filter(event_id == trace_event, is_indemnity, ceded > 0) |>
  left_join(
    mega_data$treaty_df |> select(treaty_id, name, tower_id, layer_index),
    by = "treaty_id"
    ) |>
  summarise(
    ceded       = sum(ceded),
    layers      = n_distinct(treaty_id),
    first_layer = first(name[order(coalesce(layer_index, 0))]),
    chain_rank  = first(chain_rank),
    treaty_type = first(treaty_type),
    .by = c(tower_id, treaty_id)
    ) |>
  mutate(unit = coalesce(tower_id, treaty_id)) |>
  summarise(
    ceded       = sum(ceded),
    layers      = n(),
    first_layer = first(first_layer[order(str_length(first_layer))]),
    chain_rank  = first(chain_rank),
    treaty_type = first(treaty_type),
    .by = unit
    ) |>
  arrange(chain_rank, unit) |>
  mutate(
    step = str_remove(first_layer, " \\(\\d+\\)$") |> short_name(),
    step = if_else(layers > 1, str_c(step, ", ", layers, " layers"), step)
    )

trace_gross <- top_event_tbl$gross
trace_net   <- mega_res$cells |> filter(event_id == trace_event) |> pull(net_loss) |> sum()

stopifnot(near(trace_gross - sum(trace_payer_tbl$ceded), trace_net))

# the generator against the engine, and the generator's own ordering rule
rank_edge_tbl <- mega_data$edges_df |>
  summarise(forward = sum(chain_rank_from < chain_rank_to), edges = n())
```

# Reinsurance Basics

---

*Cedants*

\


transfer premium/risk to

\


*Reinsurers*

---

Capacity

\


Volatility

\


Capital

---

$$
\text{Gross Loss} = \text{Ceded} + \text{Retained}
$$



### Quota Share (QS)

\


Proportional

\


Share of premium and losses

---

25% Quota Share

\


```{r show_qs_example}
#| echo: false

qs_tbl |>
  transmute(
    `Gross loss`  = fmt_m(gross_loss),
    !!glue("Ceded ({percent(qs_cession)} QS)") := fmt_m(ceded),
    `Net retained` = fmt_m(net)
    ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "rrr")
```


### Excess of Loss (XoL)

\

Non-proportional: pays only above *attachment*

\


Paid upfront

\


*Limit* XS *Attach*

---

14m Loss

\


```{r show_tower_example}
#| echo: false

tower_display_tbl |>
  transmute(Layer = layer, Band = band, Recovery = fmt_m(recovery)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llr")
```

---

Who pays at each loss size

```{r show_tower_allocation}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.6
#| fig-align: center

region_lvl <- c("Above tower", tower_tbl$layer[2], tower_tbl$layer[1], "Retention")
region_lbl <- c(
  "Retention"   = "Retained by cedant",
  setNames(
    glue("{tower_tbl$layer} ({fmt_limit(tower_tbl$limit)}XS{fmt_limit(tower_tbl$attachment)})"),
    tower_tbl$layer
    ),
  "Above tower" = "Above tower (cedant)"
  )
region_col <- c(
  "Retention" = "grey60", "L1" = "#0072B2", "L2" = "#E69F00", "Above tower" = "grey90"
  )

alloc_loss_vec <- c(3e6, 7e6, 12e6, 20e6, 25e6)
tower_top      <- max(tower_tbl$attachment + tower_tbl$limit)

# The tower bar: each region at its true height (retention is everything below the first layer)
tower_bar_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(region = "Retention", amount = min(tower_tbl$attachment)),
  tower_tbl |> transmute(region = layer, amount = limit)
  ) |>
  mutate(bar = "Tower")

alloc_tbl <- tibble(gross_loss = alloc_loss_vec) |>
  mutate(allocation = map(gross_loss, tower_allocation, layers = tower_tbl)) |>
  unnest(allocation) |>
  mutate(bar = fmt_limit(gross_loss) |> paste0("m"))

# Every loss is fully allocated: retention + recoveries + above tower = gross loss
stopifnot(
  alloc_tbl |>
    summarise(total = sum(amount), .by = c(gross_loss)) |>
    summarise(all(near(total, gross_loss))) |>
    pull(),
  near(sum(tower_bar_tbl$amount), tower_top)
  )

bar_lvl <- c("Tower", unique(alloc_tbl$bar))

bind_rows(tower_bar_tbl, alloc_tbl) |>
  mutate(
    region = factor(region, levels = region_lvl),
    bar    = factor(bar, levels = bar_lvl)
    ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bar, y = amount, fill = region)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(linetype = region),
      position = "stack", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, width = 0.7
      ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(tower_tbl$attachment, tower_top),
      linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40"
      ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_col, labels = region_lbl, breaks = rev(region_lvl)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Retention" = "solid", "L1" = "solid", "L2" = "solid", "Above tower" = "dashed"),
      guide = "none"
      ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, tower_tbl$attachment, tower_top, max(alloc_loss_vec)),
      labels = \(x) fmt_limit(x) |> paste0("m")
      ) +
    labs(x = "Gross loss", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right"
      )
```



### Limits and Reinstatements

---

Occurrence limit: single event

\


Aggregate limit: all events

\


Reinstatement: limit restored, usually for extra premium

---

Capacity = limit $\times$ (1 + reinstatements)

# Treaties as Functions

---

$$
Treaty: \text{Losses} \rightarrow \text{Recoveries}
$$

---

Quota Share (QS)

\


Excess of Loss (XoL)

\


Aggregate / Occurrence Limits


## Recovery Accounting


---

### 10XS10 XoL

\


10 million excess of 10 million

---

| Segment      | Gross Loss |
|--------------|-----------:|
| Construction |       5.0M |
| Legal        |      10.0M |
| I.T.         |       5.0M |
|              |            |
| Total        |      20.0M |


---

Treaty recovers 10M

---

How do we allocate them?

---

| Segment      | Treaty  | Recovery |
|--------------|---------|---------:|
| Construction | 10XS10  |     2.5M |
| Legal        | 10XS10  |     5.0M |
| I.T.         | 10XS10  |     2.5M |
|              |         |          |
| Total        | 10XS10  |    10.0M |


---

### 25% QS

\


25% quota-share (often with a limit)

---

| Segment      | Gross Loss |
|--------------|-----------:|
| Construction |       5.0M |
| Legal        |      10.0M |
| I.T.         |       5.0M |
|              |            |
| Total        |      20.0M |


---

Treaty recovers 5M

---


| Segment      | Treaty  | Recovery |
|--------------|---------|---------:|
| Construction | 25% QS  |    1.25M |
| Legal        | 25% QS  |    2.50M |

|              |         |          |

# Inuring

---

Sequencing of treaties


## Gross / Subject Losses

---

Subject Loss = Gross Loss - Inuring Recoveries

---

```{r show single_node_connected}
#| echo: false

target_node <- "XOL02_L1"  # node name/value to match

node_id <- inuring_tblgraph |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  filter(treaty_id == target_node) |>
  pull(row_id)

treaty_subgraph <- inuring_tblgraph |>
  convert(
    to_local_neighborhood,
    node  = node_id,
    order = 1,
    mode  = "in"
    )

treaty_subgraph |>
  ggraph(layout = "stress") +
  geom_edge_link(arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm")), end_cap = circle(3, "mm")) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = treaty_id)) +
  theme_graph()
```




## Topological Sort


---

Inuring graph dictates calculation order

---

```{r show_full_graph}
#| echo: false

graph_layout <- inuring_tblgraph |> igraph::layout_with_fr()

ggraph(inuring_tblgraph, layout = graph_layout) +
  geom_edge_link(
    arrow  = arrow(angle = 14, type = "closed"),
    colour = "darkgrey"
    ) +
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = treaty_id),
    size  = 2,
    repel = FALSE
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0.03)) +
  theme_graph()

```

---

::: {.custom-small}
```{r show_inuring_sort}
#| echo: false

topo_order <- inuring_tblgraph |>
  igraph::topo_sort(mode = "out")

inuring_tblgraph |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  slice(as.integer(topo_order)) |>
  transmute(
    calc_order = row_number(),
    treaty_id, treaty_type, treaty_label, description
    ) |>
  head(15) |>
  knitr::kable()

```
:::


# Orchestration

---


::: {.custom-small}
```
1. Construct graph
2. Construct treaty functions
3. Determine treaty/loss coverage
4. Topological sort
5. Loop over each node:

    a. List inuring treaties
    b. List inuring losses/recoveries
    c. Keep covered losses/recoveries
    d. Calculate subject losses
    e. Calculate recoveries

6. Gather all per-node outputs
7. Construct outputs
```
:::

### One Event: `r fmt_bn(trace_gross)` Gross, `r fmt_bn(trace_net)` Net

```{r show_event_trace}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center

trace_step_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(step = "Gross loss", xmin = 0, xmax = trace_gross, kind = "gross", label = fmt_bn(trace_gross)),
  trace_payer_tbl |>
    mutate(xmax = trace_gross - lag(cumsum(ceded), default = 0), xmin = xmax - ceded) |>
    transmute(step, xmin, xmax, kind = treaty_type, label = str_c("-", fmt_amt(ceded))),
  tibble(step = "Net loss", xmin = 0, xmax = trace_net, kind = "net", label = fmt_bn(trace_net))
  ) |>
  mutate(step = factor(step, levels = rev(step)), row = as.integer(step))

ggplot(trace_step_tbl) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = row - 0.4, ymax = row + 0.4, fill = kind)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = xmax, y = row, label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(trace_step_tbl$step)), labels = levels(trace_step_tbl$step)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-9, suffix = "bn"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(type_col, gross = "grey35", net = "grey15"),
    breaks = unique(trace_payer_tbl$treaty_type), labels = \(x) unname(type_lbl[x])
    ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  slide_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
